notes: Expanded symbol model catalog. Models are selected deterministically based on ThemeEngine extracted themes via themeTags.
themeTags are canonical theme ids from config/themes.json (tier2) plus tier1 meta themes (revelation, divine_action, human_response, time_eternity).
Most tags are assigned via filename->theme heuristics (e.g., Ruler->measure) plus any explicit .glb mentions in wowlocations.txt.
